messages:
jess (support): FYI - multiple customers reporting canary rollout tiles show 'In progress' forever. Affected rollouts: rollout-9843, rollout-9910. Console shows no recent status updates and api/rollouts/:id/status returns 502 about half the time. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1041 - paging @maya (sre) and @devon (eng-runtime).

maya (sre): looking. Any repro steps from support or customers?

jess (support): Steps we saw: 1) start canary via API 2) console shows tiles 3) metrics (success_rate, p50) show as '—' 4) status API returns 502 or empty body. Snippet from customer logs:
```
ERROR status-sync consumer: failed to decode message for rollout-9843: EOF
WARN kafka-consumer-lag: partition 12 lag=32450
```

devon (eng-runtime): that kafka lag looks bad. status-sync consumer is probably stalled. @maya can you check consumer group offsets? Run: `kubectl exec -it -n infra status-sync-0 -- ./bin/kafka-lag --group rollout-status`

maya (sre): running check now. Confirmed consumer group 'rollout-status' shows high lag on topic 'rollout-events' partitions 12-14. Spike started ~2026-02-15T01:02Z. Linking stream dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/streams/rollout-events?from=2026-02-15T01:00Z

ryan (eng-ml): Could this be caused by backpressure from the enrichment job? We recently made enrichment do a sync DB lookup; that would block the consumer thread and cause lag.

devon (eng-runtime): I see status-enricher CPU pegged on the infra nodepool. status-enricher and status-sync share a small node pool. Plan: scale enricher and bump consumer parallelism.

jess (support): Customers asking for ETA. Which clusters are affected?

maya (sre): Affected clusters: prod-us-west-2-a and prod-eu-west-1-c. Rollout IDs: rollout-9843, rollout-9910, rollout-10021. I'll run quick mitigation: scale status-enricher and restart status-sync pods to force rebalance.

devon (eng-runtime): Hotfix PR will change enrichment to async DB calls + circuit-breaker. PR: pr/eng-runtime/3527. Deploying to canary infra staging first.

oncall-bot: Deployment started: pr/eng-runtime/3527 -> infra-prod (canary) at 1779001205

maya (sre): Mitigation performed: `kubectl scale deployment/status-enricher -n infra --replicas=3` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/status-sync -n infra`. Consumer lag dropped from ~32k to <100 within 3 minutes. Monitoring: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/canary-health?rollout=rollout-9843

jess (support): Confirmed with customer A — tiles refreshed and status progressed to 'healthy' for rollout-9843. Customer B had one retry but cleared.

ryan (eng-ml): Root cause: synchronous enrichment calls caused backpressure -> consumer lag -> missed status events leading UI tiles to stay in 'In progress'. Next steps: land async patch, add consumer liveliness probe, add alert on consumer lag > 1k.

eli (product): Please create a support postmortem and notify enterprise customers who reported it. Add a note in release notes about the fix.

devon (eng-runtime): Filed PR and postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-2345
Action items:
- Merge pr/eng-runtime/3527 (owner: devon)
- Add alert: streams.rollout-events.lag > 1000 (owner: maya)
- Add regression test for status sync under enrichment load (owner: ryan)

maya (sre): I'll close the incident when metrics are stable for 1 hour. Current time series look good. :thumbsup:

jess (support): Thanks all. I'll update tickets and message customers. INC-2026-1041 -> linked to support case #46291
